**Issue #4321 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #4321: CI: a patches promotion or log is stuck
Opened by @github-actions[bot].

<!-- stuck #4312 -->
The card-patch promotion https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/pull/4312 (`patches ship`, R646) has been open over 2 hours and did not merge itself:

- [rust (test cards lib)](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/44742223234/job/136309863747)
- [rust](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/44742223234/job/136312910377)

Until it merges, the patches it ships are not live as versions: `CATALOG_VERSION` stays where it was and the patch notes do not show them.

Fix it on a branch from main: a check that only fails here usually reads the shipped history (`crates/cards/patches/`) and must hold for the history this promotion ships, so check out its branch and run the failing tests there to see it fail first, then show them pass there with the fix. A conflict alone needs no fix. Close this issue with the fix's pull request (or, for a conflict alone, by hand); the watch in `.github/workflows/patches-ship.yml` then ships again from the newer main, and that promotion supersedes this one.

If they are red for a reason outside the repository (CI out of minutes, a spending limit, billing, an account, a runner that never started), no change here fixes it: open the plan with a `**Human required:**` line saying what a person must do, and build nothing.

<!-- jackioh-bot:plan -->
## Plan

_Written by `claude-4` (claude, `opus`, strong) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/44762476792)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

**Goal.** The card-patch promotion #4312 (branch `origin/patches/ship-4b1ce2f0da`, shipping v0.6.7l) gets `rust (test cards lib)`, and so `rust`, green again. The fix goes on a branch from `main`; the shipped history (`crates/cards/patches/`) is not touched.

I ran CI's `cards lib` group on that branch: 10,044 tests passed and one failed, `scripts::stinkyscape_plus::c033_true_conservative::tests::r3538003_radiant_gives_yours_their_strongest_past_and_the_enemy_a_random_one`. It panicked at `c033_true_conservative.rs:154` with `["core-013@v0.3.1", "stand-in (3) 9/9", "stinkyscapeplus-033@v0.6.7k"]`.

The cause:
- Issue #4285 made True Conservative (S+ #33) 4/4 instead of 3/3. Once v0.6.7l ships, its 3/3 version through v0.6.7k counts as one of its past versions (R3538002).
- The Radiant face sends its controller's Units straight to `strongest(past)`, so the True Conservative just played turns itself into its own weaker 3/3 (Radiant 6/6) past version.
- The base face never does this. `transform_random` leaves the running card and its past versions out of the pool (R387, R3538002; `excluding_def_id` in `crates/engine/src/effects/transform.rs`).

Done means:
- The Radiant face leaves every True Conservative alone, as the base face does.
- New ruling R4321000 records this, and §8 row S+ #33 says it.
- A test that does not depend on the shipped history proves it.
- The cards' lib tests pass on this branch and on the promotion's branch with the fix applied.

I applied this exact change to the promotion's branch as a trial:
- With it, all six True Conservative tests pass, the one CI caught among them.
- Without the guard, both the new test and the CI-failing test fail.
- `cargo fmt --check -p jackioh-cards` and `cargo clippy -p jackioh-cards --all-targets -- -D warnings` are clean.

| Path | new/change | What |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/c033_true_conservative.rs` | change | A guard in `face`'s Radiant branch; the header comment; the comment in the base test; the new test `r4321000_neither_face_turns_a_true_conservative_into_its_own_past` |
| `spec/rulings/R4321000.md` | new | The ruling note |
| `spec/pending/4321.md` | new | The ruling's §11 paragraph |
| `spec/08-catalog.md` | change | Row S+ #33, True Conservative (line 879): one sentence in its last column |

Do not touch:
- anything under `crates/cards/patches/`: no pending fragment, no `patches.json`, `shipped.json` or snapshot edit;
- `crates/cards/catalog.json`, `loc` included;
- `crates/engine`, `crates/cards/src/history.rs` (`KEPT_SCRIPTS`);
- `spec/11-rulings.md`, `spec/INDEX.md`, `spec/CARDS.md`;
- `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, `.claude/`.

Do not run `cargo jackioh spec index`.

Governing rules: §6.3 (Transform), §8 row S+ #33, R387, R3538002, R3538003, R767000, R2173001, and R1370000 (classify's claims).

1. **Guard, in `face` in `c033_true_conservative.rs`.** Find the branch `if radiant && player == controller {`. Insert this as its first statements, before `let Some(strong) = strongest(&past, wears_radiant) else {`:
   ```rust
                    // R387, R4321000: never one of this card's own versions, as the base face's pool
                    // leaves them out.
                    if past_card_of(&def_id) == ID {
                        continue;
                    }
   ```
   `past_card_of` is already in scope through `jackioh_engine::prelude::*`. Change nothing else in the script. The base face and the enemy's units already leave every True Conservative alone through the engine's exclusion.

2. **Header comment, same file.**
   - In line 1, replace `3/3 → 6/6.` with `4/4 → 8/8 (3/3 → 6/6 through v0.6.7k, issue #4285).`
   - After the line ending `A Transform fires no Cry (R1) and an Immutable card refuses (R23).`, add:

     //! No True Conservative, this one or another on either side, becomes one of its own past versions on
     //! either face (R4321000): the base face's pool leaves them out (R387), and the Radiant face skips them.
     ```

   ```rust
        // Yours: True Conservative itself (no past) and the stand-in stand on, core-013 became one
        // of its past versions.

        // Yours: True Conservative itself (never its own past, R4321000) and the stand-in (no past)
        // stand on, core-013 became one of its past versions.

    /// played or another on either side, though its crafted past here (9/9, Radiant 18/18) is its
    /// strongest; core-013 beside it still turns, so the Cry ran.
    #[test]
    fn r4321000_neither_face_turns_a_true_conservative_into_its_own_past() {
        crate::register_all();
        let past_of = |card: &str, attack: i32, health: i32| {
            let mut def = crate::card_def(card).clone();
            def.id = format!("{card}{PAST_ID_MARK}v0");
            def.base.attack = Some(attack);
            def.base.health = Some(health);
            def.radiant.attack = Some(attack * 2);
            def.radiant.health = Some(health * 2);
            def
        };
        let old_past = past_of(OLD, 1, 6);
        register_past_defs(vec![old_past.clone(), past_of(ID, 9, 9)]);
        for radiant in [false, true] {
            let mut s = scenario(json!({
                "seed": format!("true-conservative-itself-{radiant}"),
                "p1": {
                    "hand": [{ "def": ID, "radiant": radiant }, "core-005"],
                    "field": [{ "def": OLD, "lane": 1 }, { "def": ID, "lane": 2 }],
                    "library": ["core-005", "core-005", "core-005", "core-005"],
                    "mana": 4,
                },
                "p2": {
                    "hand": ["core-005"],
                    "field": [{ "def": ID, "lane": 1 }],
                    "library": ["core-005", "core-005", "core-005", "core-005"],
                },
            }));
            s.play(ID, json!({ "zone": 3 }));
            let def_at = |player: PlayerId, lane: i32| s.unit(player, lane).map(|unit| unit.def_id.clone());
            assert_eq!(def_at(P1, 1), Some(old_past.id.clone()), "radiant {radiant}: the Cry ran");
            for (player, lane) in [(P1, 2), (P1, 3), (P2, 1)] {
                assert_eq!(
                    def_at(player, lane),
                    Some(ID.to_string()),
                    "radiant {radiant}: {player:?}'s lane {lane}"
                );
            }
        }
    }

   ```

5. **`spec/rulings/R4321000.md`** (new), exactly:
   ```markdown

Rejected: letting the Radiant face turn its controller's True Conservatives into their strongest past version, which, once issue #4285's 4/4 ships over the 3/3 it was through v0.6.7k, turns the card just played into its own weaker 3/3 (Radiant 6/6), a downgrade the base face never makes.
   ```

No shipped version gave the card a past (it was 3/3 from its build through v0.6.7k), so no stored game changes ([[R767000]]). Rejected: the Radiant face turning the card played into its own weaker 3/3 once v0.6.7l ships. It edits [[§8]] row S+ #33.
   ```

7. **`spec/08-catalog.md`, line 879** (the row starting `| 33 | True Conservative |`). In its last cell, right after `([[R3538002]], [[R3538003]]).`, insert one space and then `No True Conservative, the one played or another on either side, becomes one of its own past versions on either face ([[R387]], [[R4321000]]).` Change nothing else in the row, and add no `|`.

8. **Prove it on the promotion's branch, as the issue asks.** Run from this worktree's root:
   ```

   cd - && git worktree remove --force ../jackioh-wt/ship-4312
   ```
   - The patch applies cleanly: the file is the same on both branches.
   - Expect `test result: ok. 10046 passed; 0 failed` (10,044 + 1 failing that now passes + 1 new). The first build takes about 15 minutes on 4 cores.
   - Quote that line in the report.
   - If the ref no longer exists (a newer promotion replaced it), say so and skip this step.

## Tests

- File: `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/c033_true_conservative.rs`.
  - New, `r4321000_neither_face_turns_a_true_conservative_into_its_own_past`: on both faces, with a crafted past that is stronger than the card itself, p1's core-013 turns into its crafted past, and p1's lanes 2 and 3 and p2's lane 1 are still `stinkyscapeplus-033`. It fails without step 1.
  - Existing `r3538003_radiant_gives_yours_their_strongest_past_and_the_enemy_a_random_one`: passes on both `main` and the promotion's history.
- Commands, run in this worktree:
  - `cargo test -p jackioh-cards c033_true_conservative`: six tests pass.
  - `cargo test -p jackioh-cards --lib`
  - `cargo fmt --check`
  - `cargo clippy -p jackioh-cards --all-targets -- -D warnings`
  - `cargo jackioh spec check`
  - `cargo jackioh patches check`: passes with no fragment, since no catalog entry changes.
  - Step 8's command on the promotion's branch.

## Done when

- [ ] The guard, header, comment and new test are in `c033_true_conservative.rs` (steps 1–4).
- [ ] `R4321000.md`, `spec/pending/4321.md` and the §8 row edit are in (steps 5–7).
- [ ] The cards' lib tests pass on this branch, and on `origin/patches/ship-4b1ce2f0da` with the fix applied (step 8, its result line quoted), or the report says the ref was gone. The scratch worktree is removed.
- [ ] These harness checks pass: rustfmt, catalog, patches, rulings (`spec check`), clippy and cargo tests.
- [ ] Nothing under `crates/cards/patches/` changed (`git status` shows only the four files).
- [ ] The report says this fix's pull request closes #4321. The watch then ships again from the newer `main`, and that promotion replaces #4312.

## Risks

- **Replays and determinism.** No shipped version gave True Conservative a past. It was 3/3 from its build through v0.6.7k, and `past_ids` leaves out the run that holds the reference version. So the guard changes no stored game, draws nothing from the RNG, and needs no `KEPT_SCRIPTS` row. It only matters from v0.6.7l on, and this fix ships before v0.6.7l does.
- **`rust (classify)`.** Stage 1 flags the script, but stage 2's forced games on `main`'s build find no difference, because the card has no past there (the catalog version is still v0.6.7k). **Do not add a pending fragment:** R1370000 fails a fragment whose `plays` the base build does not show.
- **Code lines (R2173001).** The script has about 65 code lines, which is over the complicated threshold of 60 and under the BUSTED threshold of 100. The three added lines cross neither, so no card moves between lists and xxFreshJack and Shockwave447 play as before. Add no other code.
- **`loc` in `catalog.json`** is frozen data (`docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` §3). Leave it.
- **Test isolation.** `register_past_defs` holds only for the test's own thread, as the existing `crafted_past` tests rely on.
- **Hidden information and the client:** untouched.

## Open questions

- **The card's design (only a person can decide).** The plan rules that the Radiant face never turns a True Conservative into its own past (R4321000). The alternative is that the designer wants "Yours become their strongest version" to also turn the card just played into its own past version, even though that is a downgrade. In that case drop steps 1–7. Instead change only the failing test, so that p1's lane-3 unit is expected to be `strongest(&past_ids_of(ID), true)` whenever `past_ids_of(ID)` is not empty. I rejected that because it makes the Radiant face act on itself where the base face never does (R387).
- **Difficulty.** No change to the rating: the change touches one card script and the spec, with no engine rule, AI, migration or cross-crate design.
````
